note: Named map extents for the family story (kit/docs/story.md). A map's `extent` is either one of these names or its own box: {west, east, south, north, projection}. Longitude and latitude in degrees. `projection` is how degrees become a flat picture: 'equirectangular' (the default: x is scaled by the cosine of the middle latitude, so a town does not look stretched), 'plate-carree' (degrees are degrees; honest only near the equator) or 'mercator' (north-up navigation chart; stretches the poles). A name here is only a box and a projection: the coastline for it comes from story-basemap.json when a layer of that name covers the box, and from the 50m outlines in outlines.json when the box is small.
